revision_summary: No fabricated/failed quotes per the deterministic check, and the core trajectory read (confused open → cooperative verify → credit DQ with no alt path) and outcome reclassification to DQ are well-supported. However, three targeted fixes are needed before approval: (1) Reclassify objections[0].type from 'trust_or_scam' to a credit/qualifier-based objection type — nothing in the customer's quote at 02:48 references trust or scam concerns, only credit history from a prior solar attempt. (2) Correct script_coverage's 'tax_credit_qualifier' entry resistance_reason from 'cost' to something reflecting credit/qualification (e.g., 'credit_score'/'qualifier_failure') — mislabeling this as a cost objection will corrupt per-rep pattern aggregation on cost vs. credit-DQ distinctions. (3) Soften starting_state and cherry_pick_moments[0]'s framing of the 00:00-00:32 segment: this reads as an automated receptionist/screening message ('record your name and reason for calling... please stay on the line'), not rep-attributable confusion, and should not be scored against intros.standard compliance or characterized as a 'rocky, low-legitimacy start' without that caveat foregrounded — the rep's actual intro at 00:37 is clean and reasonably schema-compliant. Additionally, consider adding a cherry_pick_moment for the vague 'incentives and credits and stuff' line at 03:00 as a knowledge_gap_handling instance, and tighten coaching_focus[1]'s invented rep-alternative language to explicitly flag it as an untested suggestion pending Kenny's resolution of the stated-vs-pulled-credit policy question, per the schema's own operator note.
